accounts.control_policy: NO_TRADE; separate durable simulated cash account; zero cash yield assumption; no fees without fills; not funded with real money

activation_status: BLOCKED_FOR_OPERATIONAL_ISOLATION: no reviewed arbitrary-policy standalone runner, authenticated independent source/account custody or shared-IP resource proof; never dispatch ordinary continuous-paper workflow or activate PR1392.
costs: Cost reserve bps=9+latest full spread+10+2*abs(current hourly funding rate)*10000. Reserve is a decision hurdle, NOT a forecast or booked cash. Actual fills already include spread/impact, never deduct them twice. Existing PaperExecutionAdapter taker fees250ms latency, 25bp IOC cap/freshness/depth/partial/no-fill rules unchanged. Actual hourly funding cash/oracle required; gaps UNKNOWN and block new entries and qualification, never zero.
cross_market_selection: At each30s decision boundary evaluate every observed eligible native market using only observations received by that boundary. Persist all decisions, including missing-input NO_TRADE, qualified-but-capacity-blocked and risk-rejected cases. Sort qualified candidates by canonical market key lexicographically (deterministic tie/queue rule, not an alpha rank). Select the first passing all unchanged independent risk/margin/venue/minimum-notional and trial caps. At most ONE IOC opening submission per decision epoch; no-fill/partial does not authorize another market attempt in that epoch. Pending/open exposure blocks new entry as specified. Venue discovery stays broad; no preferred ticker list.
disable: Any integrity/clock/gap/funding/margin/health/account mismatch =>no NEW exposure, keep stops/exit management. Three losses =>1h cooldown, six actual openings/day limit, same market1h cooldown; trial marked equity<=9950 permanently disables entries for v1, preserving exits and losses. Existing daily/weekly/risk guards remain stricter if triggered. No automatic reset/retry/version replacement.
entry: All ordinary native-perp eligibility gates remain. Pressure >=20 trades and 3x baseline mean-minute notional, >=70% one aggressor side, signed anchor-to-pressure-last-mid displacement>=40bp. Anchor=first pressure book. Extreme=pressure min-mid book for LONG/max-mid for SHORT (first tie). Latest mid reverses>=10bp; no confirmation mid breaches extreme by>5bp. Same fixed price band at extreme best bid [bid*(1-10bp),bid] for LONG/ask [ask,ask*(1+10bp)] for SHORT: supporting quote depth at BOTH the last book at/before response_start=t-10s (book receipt and exchange age<=1s at that boundary) AND latest book>=1.5x positive extreme depth; original-side confirmation trades INSIDE fixed band received BEFORE response_start execute notional>=extreme depth. Recovery must therefore precede the measured opposing-response window. Last10s >=5trades with >=55% opposing notional. Spread<=5bp. Target=anchor mid; stop beyond pressure extreme mid by10bp; distance<=100bp. Target room>=2x stop distance and>=2x estimated roundtrip costs. LONG after sell pressure; SHORT after buy pressure; otherwise reasoned NO_TRADE.
exits: Protective reduce-only stop first, target anchor second, maximum30min from first fill third. No trailing/breakeven/extension/parameter response to wins or losses. Expired entry2s =>missed/no chase. Reconcile partial fills and pending reduce-only intents across handoffs; execution can remain open after exit trigger until genuine executable liquidity arrives; record gap/slippage/loss beyond target risk.

inference_contract.bootstrap: Pythonrandom.Random(1258),5000replicates. For Ccalendar clusters draw Ccluster indices independently with replacement using randrange(C); concatenate whole component-return lists from drawn clusters, preserving empty clusters. Statistic=equal-weight mean of all included component returns; empty replicate=>inference not established (never discard). One-sided95%lower bound=sorted5000means[floor(0.05*(5000-1))]; must>0. All original component records/costs remain. Positive bound alone is insufficient.
inference_contract.clusters: Fixed48hour calendar clusters anchored T0, seven at14days or fourteen at28days, including zero-trade clusters. Assign full components by firstfill for component inference; any UNKNOWN component prevents validation. Dependence may persist beyond48h; disclose few-cluster limitations.
inference_contract.component: One connected overlapping actual lifecycle component; with one position normally one lifecycle. Nonoverlap does NOT establish statistical independence. Return=full realized component gross minus all entry/exit fees plus all actual funding cash, divided by whole-account equity immediately BEFORE first fill (entry fee therefore included). Missing source/funding or not fully closed by evaluation end=>UNKNOWN, never excluded or zero-imputed. Complete marked account includes open positions regardless.
inference_contract.extension: Only insufficient predeclared sample counts at14days permits unchanged extension to28days. Adequate-sample economic/source failure cannot earn extension, reset or new version. Equal elapsed thirds are defined for each PREDECLARED14/28day review horizon; original14day result always preserved.

lineage: Touched321original trades motivate but do not causally identify mechanism. Previous temporary pressure mechanism was historical DATA-BLOCKED, not tested/rejected. Old static imbalance/candle reclaim/rank/carry/repricing failures and source gaps preserved. No historical grid search or winner-derived thresholds.
mechanism: Temporary immediacy demand may displace price; visible liquidity recovery plus opposing executed response may precede normalization. Participant identity and same-maker replenishment are unobserved.
prospective: No outcome collection before immutable release and independent activation receipt. Receipt binds exact code SHA, this protocol SHA256, market universe rule, fee/risk config, two fresh account IDs and isolated roots, resource lease, scheduled future first-entry boundary >=release+6h, source chain. Warmup starts before boundary; do not backdate or shift it after outcomes. First review14calendar days after boundary; if fewer40non-overlapping lifecycle components,5markets,10LONG,10SHORT,10components in each fixed chronological third =>INCONCLUSIVE; one predeclared extension to28days with unchanged rules, then final INCONCLUSIVE if still insufficient. >=72h complete original source is necessary for validation, never for starting. No interim optimization.
sizing: q=floor_to_szDecimals(min(0.001*equity/(abs(executable_entry-stop)+executable_entry*cost_bps/10000),0.25*equity/executable_entry,0.05*contra_depth_25bp/executable_entry)). Independent existing risk, margin, minimum notional and correlation approvals may only reduce/reject. One position and one pending opening trial-wide, no averaging, pyramids or martingale. Stops defined before first fill; partial qty only.
validation: All accounts/fills/funding/marks/gaps/no-fills/partials/decisions retained; independently reconcile every event account-equity and gross-fees+funding cash identity. Positive absolute after-all-cost marked equity above10000 and positive difference versus capital-matched control, adequate samples, positive marked-account net change in each fixed equal-ELAPSED-TIME chronological third anchored at immutable entry boundary T0. Components assigned by first fill ONLY for counts/attribution, never as a substitute for marked account period returns; preserve crossing components. Maximum peak-to-trough marked drawdown<=0.5% is an independent validation gate, distinct from fixed initial-capital equity<=9950 entry-disable floor; gaps may overshoot and then fail validation. Dependence-aware inference follows inference_contract. Report market/side/winner concentration and top-winner/top-market removal as sensitivity, not automatic disproof. Sample, source or inference failure=>not validated. Successful exploratory trial still requires existing independent OOS/walk-forward/shadow/promotion gates before champion/LIVE.
window_convention: t is a 30s UTC grid. baseline [t-690s,t-90s); pressure [t-90s,t-30s); confirmation [t-30s,t]; response [t-10s,t]. Use original receipt times, never re-sort; exchange times cannot be future or lag receipt by >2s. Baseline is ten equal prior minutes; complete tape and >=1 trade per minute required. Book coverage starts at pressure start with first book <=1s later, max gap2s, final book<=1s old. Exchange clocks must be nondecreasing per (kind,market). Latest book BOTH original receipt and exchange ages<=1s. Coverage flags/source strings/local digests alone do not authenticate completeness.
